property_summary: For any caller and any input address _keeper, calling setKeeper(_keeper) on the correct contract updates keeper() to the provided _keeper; the mutant instead sets keeper() to address(0) breaking this invariant for some inputs.
change_summary: Change setKeeper to require onlyOwner removed (no longer restricted) and emit different KeeperUpdated value by setting keeper to address(0) instead of provided _keeper.
